contracts.admission: Privileged local server composition fixes jobId/capability, injected PostgreSQL query/transaction/lock, policy, transport, clock and timers. run/inspect accept only an opaque handle (run also accepts cancellation). No interactive entry point, session, captain, viewport or mission input.
contracts.authority: CP-02 row-locked claim/check/accept plus deferred fenced_commit remains the sole acceptance authority. CP-02/CP-03 source/functions/contracts remain unchanged. Recovery inspection takes the same registry/ownership lock order and waits for in-flight acceptance before reporting a decision.
contracts.raw: cp04.raw_checkpoints atomically associates an attempt with its exact cp02.raw content hash, original server transport URL/provider/dataset and first database retention time. It never attributes legacy raw-only orphans lacking a protected source association.
contracts.replay: cp04.replays immutably links each replaying attempt to the source attempt and exact raw hash. Reclaimed attempt-local acquisition/normalization timestamps describe durable transport replay, not a new external HTTP response; original origin/first retention and any old staged execution are preserved. Selected provider time must still come from the unchanged protected policy and match the original URL exactly.
contracts.evidence: A live staged original attempt accepts its exact validated original record without selecting time, acquiring transport or normalizing again. Reclaim uses authoritative exact retained raw bytes through unchanged Phase 2 processing and must reproduce the original exact capture/reference if one already exists; only execution/binding identity changes for the new fence. No replacement capture identity is minted merely to make recovery succeed.
contracts.ancestry: Bounded immutable replay ancestry preserves the original evidence constraint through repeated raw-only crashes. A live same-attempt replay retry preserves its existing replay-source link. A source reference is required when prior attributed artifacts exist.
contracts.uncertain: After a lost staging ACK, exact original readback reconciles staging. After uncertain acceptance/COMMIT, fresh authoritative PostgreSQL inspection determines whether acceptance committed. No blind acceptance retry. If reconciliation is unavailable, return INDETERMINATE with accepted:null. If rollback is confirmed only through an authoritative missing decision, a later explicit retry verifies staging and current fencing before reclaim/accept.
contracts.accepted: Already accepted jobs return the fully validated original CP-03 chain as ACCEPTED_HISTORICAL without acquisition or writes. An archival retry of a stale/expired/revoked capability is a historical read, never a new stale acceptance.
contracts.intermediate: Accepted lookup paths never expose unaccepted raw/evidence/binding. Evidence, binding and staging commit atomically in CP-03; process death inside either insertion rolls the partial transaction back.
contracts.conflicts: Raw hash/reference/origin, exact capture/reference, record hash, execution/binding or source ancestry conflicts fail closed as INTEGRITY_FAILED. No runtime overwrite or delete is used to repair history.
contracts.serialization: Dedicated-session per-job PostgreSQL advisory locking serializes bounded recovery invocations and disappears on process/database death. It is operational serialization only, not a fencing or acceptance authority.

developmentReconciliation: Qualification subprocesses required authorized elevated execution to leave sandbox spawn restriction; no system configuration changes
Owner fixture setup made sequential so three registry transactions cannot interleave on one admin connection
Original staged capture constraint is retained through replay ancestry, including repeated intermediate crashes
Same-attempt raw replay keeps its existing source pointer; added regression passes
Advisory unlock failure destroys the lock connection while preserving a verified committed result
boundariesPreserved: Acquisition remains server-controlled and independent of captain/session/app activity
Existing CURRENTS V3 and normalization validators unchanged
No Ocean State, publishing, frontend or production work
remainingLimitations: Isolated synthetic-provider qualification only, not an operational scheduler or production/science qualification
Recovery is explicit and bounded to one registered job; caller retries BUSY/RECOVERABLE/INDETERMINATE and provides a new private capability for a fenced/released attempt
Lock composition requires a dedicated session connection plus query/transaction capacity; the qualified harness uses a six-connection pool
Legacy raw-only orphans with no authoritative attempt/source attribution cannot safely be reused; legacy revoked stages without original context remain audit-only/fail closed
Original request/receive timestamps lost before stage creation are not fabricated; raw-only replay preserves first retention/origin and records new local replay timings
Request/provider-time mismatch and integrity conflict require trusted investigation; recovery does not overwrite, select alternate evidence or contact transport as a fallback
Migration/admin/superuser authority remains a trust root and can disable protections; tamper qualification rolled such fault changes back
No automatic restart, service, recovery queue, garbage collection, retention policy, Receipt Writer, Ocean State or publishing integration
